specName: Implement fans out large Foundational waves

spec: Write every scenario as WHEN/THEN with exactly one observable outcome
Reserve backticks for real identifiers a reader would copy, never ordinary nouns
plan: Name the capability each decision belongs to, so the fold knows where it goes
Prefer extending the file that already owns a concern over adding a new one

commands-completion: Completion is an explicit terminal step with exactly one writer
Completion accounts for every loaded capability — a delta or an explicit skip, never silence
A run that loaded nothing says so, because that is the one silence nothing else catches
The tasks Polish phase validates the spec's Success Criteria in exactly one place
commands-living: Living-spec commands are opt-in, non-halting, and honest about what they did not examine
One command syncs every affected living spec from the current changes, uncommitted included
A spec that is still true can say so, and stop drifting
A living spec is readable one slice at a time, from a terminal
